label: Launching something new
summary: Ground product launches in concrete user benefits
State availability dates and release tiers clearly
tone_principles: Enthusiastic yet credible, grounded in observable capabilities.
writing_style: Engaging feature introductions supported by specific use cases.
messaging_principles: Celebrate new product launches by showing tangible problems solved rather than relying on empty buzzwords.

rules.title: Substantiate Launch Claims & Product Novelty
rules.description: Product launches must describe features accurately without unverified claims of historical uniqueness.
rules.do_example: We are excited to introduce our newly upgraded reporting dashboard.
rules.dont_example: This revolutionary miracle changes everything forever across human history!

terminology.notes: Describe new launches with credible excitement.
